name: How to Unlock a PDF
description: Remove password protection from a PDF using its correct password — 100% in your browser.

step.name: Upload your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your PDF into the drop zone.

step.name: Enter the password
step.text: Type the PDF's current password, if one is required.

step.name: Download the unlocked PDF
step.text: Click 'Remove Password Protection'. An unlocked copy downloads immediately.
